# Stacy

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>
- **Role:** teacher  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>
- **Titles:** Miss Stacy  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010)</sub>; Miss  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010)</sub>

## Appearance

Miss Stacy is a young woman with fair curly hair and captivating eyes. She dresses beautifully and wears notable sleeve puffs.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)_

## Personality

Miss Stacy is a bright, sympathetic person who easily wins the affection of her pupils. She encourages her students to achieve their mental and moral potential without relying on physical punishment.

_Sources: [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v2 c4 P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007)_

## Traits

- bright  <sub>[v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>
- sympathetic  <sub>[v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>

## Abilities

- winning and holding pupils' affections  <sub>[v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>

- bringing out the best in her pupils mentally and morally  <sub>[v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>

## History

Miss Muriel Stacy was hired by the trustees as Avonlea's first female school teacher. She introduced new teaching practices, such as morning and evening physical culture exercises, biweekly recitation afternoons, and outdoor field days to study nature. She formed a special Queen's class to thoroughly drill interested pupils for the Entrance examination, resulting in all her candidates passing. Her term at Avonlea school ended in June, though she later returned to the area for visits and social occasions.

_Sources: [v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c30 P28](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0028), [v1 c31 P28](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0028), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000), [v1 c32 P42](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0042), [v2 c16 P22](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0022)_
